exhibits.quote: The two things I loved about Columns: 1. easy to share with audiences via links, 2. ability to restrict embeds to specific domains for those who share via webpublishing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms sharing via links and embedding with domain restriction works as promised.

exhibits.quote: I use columns to embed charts and anylse data in Notion. It works very well.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms embedding charts works very well in practice.

- Lifetime access to Columns Ai Plan

trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so the $79 price and $900 former price cannot be verified from the evidence shown.

trials.claimQuote:
- AI-assisted data storytelling
- Unlimited data connections
- Unlimited publishing & embedding
- Unlimited story auto-update by schedule
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm Columns uses generative AI to help craft stories and turn raw CSV data into data-storytelling presentations. The prosecution exhibits only suggest the AI's colours and summaries could improve, not that AI storytelling is absent.

exhibits.quote: It does not automatically tell the story colour wise this could be improved I had to change colours to make real distinctions to the viewers e.g. gender.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the AI did not automatically tell the story visually and required manual intervention.

exhibits.quote: The summary could be even more insightful but I think the AI language needs to be trained
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the AI summary lacks insightfulness, which undermines the AI-assisted storytelling claim.

exhibits.quote: Columns is an amazing tool not just because it is so simple and easy to create beautiful charts and tell stories with data - it uses generative AI to help you craft that story.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool uses generative AI to help craft data stories.

exhibits.quote: This program has allowed me to be able to analyze,storeytell and visualize a bunch of raw data from a simple csv file intoa live like Sophisticated visualized and statiscally accurate data storytelling presentation.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool converts raw data into data storytelling presentation.
